generation_parameters.prompt: Make a 6-column x 4-row transparent orthographic pixel-art atlas for the four supplied terrain objects. Columns exactly front, top, right, left, bottom, rear. Rows exactly ice-patch, moss-floor, poison-puddle, cracked-stone-floor matching references. One complete centered object per cell, consistent footprint and same material/palette as its source. True orthographic views: top straight down, bottom straight up, rear opposite front. Preserve the original tile's recognizable surface pattern when seen from above; infer thickness/underside consistently. No scenery, ground plane, cast shadows, labels, perspective, border or grid marks. Crisp game pixel-art clusters. Transparent background.

provenance.notes: Unmodified raw generation retained for review and reproducibility.
